SELECT e.no AS enrollment_no, e.member_id AS member_id, e.exam_no AS exam_no, e.theme AS theme, e.totalscore AS total_score, e.status AS status, TO_CHAR(e.starttime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS start_time, TO_CHAR(e.endtime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS end_time, ROUND((CAST(e.endtime AS DATE)-CAST(e.starttime AS DATE))*24*60*60) AS spent_seconds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_user_answer WHERE enrollment_no=e.no) AS total_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_user_answer a JOIN exam_question q ON a.question_no=q.no WHERE a.enrollment_no=e.no AND q.type!=1) AS subjective_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_user_answer a JOIN exam_question q ON a.question_no=q.no WHERE a.enrollment_no=e.no AND q.type!=1 AND a.is_correct!='W') AS subjective_graded FROM exam_enrollment e WHERE e.no=#{enrollmentNo}

SELECT a.no AS answer_no, a.question_no AS question_no, a.user_answer AS user_answer, a.is_correct AS is_correct, a.score AS score, q.title AS title, q.image AS image, q.answer AS standard_answer, q.description AS description, q.type AS question_type FROM exam_user_answer a JOIN exam_question q ON a.question_no = q.no WHERE a.enrollment_no = #{enrollmentNo} ORDER BY a.question_no ASC
